newsitem.title: DENMARK: EAC and Danish state take over China's INC.
newsitem.headline: EAC and Danish state take over China's INC.

text.p: Danish trading group East Asiatic Company (EAC) said on Thursday that it and the Danish state's Industrialisation Fund for Developing Countries (IFU) had taken over China's Shanghai International Nutrition Company (INC) after buying out a local partner.
A group statement said its EAC Hong Kong unit and the IFU had acquired the 29 percent holding of an unnamed Chinese partner which was unable to keep up with the joint venture's capital needs.
Subject to approval by Chinese authorities the deal leaves EAC with 75 percent of INC and the Danish state with the rest.

INC, which started production in 1995, produces infant milk powder, yoghurt and other milk products, including milk shakes for McDonald's restaurants in the Shanghai area. --Chris Follett, Copenhagen newsroom +45-33969652
